Interface IBroadphase

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a broadphase collision detection system interface. Inherits from IBounds. Provides methods for managing collision objects and retrieving candidate buckets for collision checks. CollisionHandler is using this interface to perform broadphase collision detection.

public interface IBroadphase : IBounds

Fill(IEnumerable<CollisionObject>)

Populates the broadphase system with the provided collection of collision bodies.

void Fill(IEnumerable<CollisionObject> collisionBodies)

Parameters

collisionBodies IEnumerable<CollisionObject>

An enumerable collection of CollisionObject instances to add to the broadphase.

Remarks

The collision handler will call fill every frame before performing collision checks. You can either rebuild the broadphase from scratch or update existing entries. collisionBodies contains all active collision bodies currently in the system.
